Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 33180 of 2022
Applicant :- Sanjay Adhana

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sheo Ram Singh,Raj Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit on behalf of the applicant and supplementary counter affidavit on behalf of the State filed today, are taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Raj Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B.Maurya, learned AGA-I, for the State.
3.

The instant bail application has been moved on behalf of the applicant to release him on bail in Case Crime No.48 of 2016, under Sections 420,467,468,471,323,504 and 506 IPC, Police Station Ecotech-1, District Gautam Budh Nagar during pendency of the trial.

entities.text: Police Station Ecotech-1, District Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
4. According to the allegation, the Firm of applicant committed fraud and cheated the informant and in spite of the execution of the sale deed in his favour did not provide possession over the property and when he tried to take possession then he was manhandled by the Officers of the company including applicant.
5.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the entire allegation made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and although as per FIR, applicant was the owner of the Firm but in fact applicant is not having any concern with the alleged Firm and further even as per the FIR the sale deed in question was executed by Nand Kishor one of the employee of the Firm and there is no allegation that applicant either received any money or he allured the informant in any manner or executed the alleged sale deed.

He further submits that co-accused Nand Kishor, who executed sale Sanjay Adhana vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109903373/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: deed has already been released on bail by Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 1.8.2022 passed in Criminal Misc.Bail Application No.1539 of 2022.

6. He next submits that although as per allegation alleged sale deed was executed in the year 2013 but FIR of the present case was lodged in the year 2016, i.e., after about three years and all the offences are triable by Magistrate First Class and applicant in the present matter is in Jail since 6.4.2021, i.e,, for the last more than one and half years and, therefore, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
7.

He further submits that although applicant is having long criminal history of forty cases but he has explained criminal history of applicant in paragraph-8 of the supplementary affidavit filed in support of the present bail application and in several cases he has been released on bail.

8. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that applicant being owner of the alleged Firm duped the informant and he is having long criminal antecedent but could not dispute the fact that the person, who executed the sale deed has been released on bail and applicant in the present matter is in Jail since April, 2021 and all the offences are triable by Magistrate First Class. .
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. From the perusal of the FIR it appears that in spite of receiving money and execution of sale deed in favour of the informant, no possession of the land was handed over to him by the firm of applicant and when he tried to possess his property then he was manhandled by employees of the Firm of applicant and applicant is also having long criminal history of forty cases but considering the fact that co-accused Nand Kishor, who executed the sale deed has been released on bail by Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 1.8.2022 passed in Criminal Misc.Bail Application No. 1539 of 2022 and all the offences are triable by Magistrate First Class and applicant in the present matter is in jail since April, 2021, i.e., for the last more than one and half years and the FIR of the present case was lodged after three years, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

11. In the light of discussions made above, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
the instant bail application is allowed.

12. Let the applicant-Sanjay Adhana be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from Sanjay Adhana vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109903373/
2 disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

sentences.text: (iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
13. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
